prompt_text: What is the best AI video ad maker?
answer_verbatim:
For most businesses making short-form paid social ads, **Creatify** is probably the best all-around AI video ad maker.

It is especially strong for turning a product URL into multiple ad variations with:
- AI-generated scripts and hooks
- UGC-style/avatar presenters
- Product-focused video creatives
- Multiple aspect ratios for TikTok, Reels, YouTube Shorts, and Meta
- Fast A/B-test variations

Other strong choices depending on your needs:

| Need | Best option | Why |
|---|---|---|
| Best overall performance-ad workflow | **Creatify** | Designed around ecommerce and ad variations |
| Realistic AI spokesperson / avatar ads | **HeyGen** | Very strong avatars, voices, localization |
| Enterprise training or polished presenter videos | **Synthesia** | Professional, controlled avatar production |
| Fast social ads from templates | **Canva** | Easiest for non-designers; great brand controls |
| Editing existing footage into ads | **CapCut** | Excellent short-form editing, captions, effects |
| Product URL-to-video ads | **InVideo AI** | Simple prompt/URL workflow and stock footage |
| AI UGC-style ads | **Arcads** | Focused on creator-style ad production |

### My practical recommendation
- **Ecommerce brand running TikTok/Meta ads:** Creatify or Arcads  
- **SaaS/company needing an AI spokesperson:** HeyGen  
- **Small business wanting easy templates and design control:** Canva  
- **Creator editing real product footage:** CapCut  

The “best” tool is usually the one that lets you generate **many credible creative variations quickly**, not necessarily the one with the most realistic AI avatars. For ad results, prioritize good hooks, clear product footage, subtitles, social-proof messaging, and rapid testing.
